statement.excerpt: And so, of course, the Democrats are going to investigate this. It’s going to be top-line investigation…. throughout at least the next year, but maybe going longer.
statement.document_title: Breaking: Jensen is back. And the market is way up. But things will never be the same.

from_speaker: the Democrats are going to investigate this
throughout at least the next year
our_interpretation: The congressional context identifies the investigators as congressional Democrats.
A top-line investigation means a prominent investigative priority, demonstrated by leadership attention and sustained substantive investigative activity.

The next year could mean the following twelve months or calendar 2027. The horizon ends on December 31, 2027, the latest plausible endpoint; the minimum-duration reading runs through November 23, 2027.
Possibly continuing longer adds no firm commitment beyond the minimum period.
criteria.support_condition: Official records show a prominent Democratic congressional investigation into the Huang/Nvidia matter sustained through the specified period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records establish that no qualifying investigation occurred, or that it definitively ended before completing the promised minimum duration.
